explanation: This is safe. fgets reads at most sizeof(buf) - 1 characters and NUL-terminates the buffer, so even an arbitrarily long input line cannot overflow the 64-byte array. A tempting wrong answer assumes gets()-style unbounded reading, which is exactly the vulnerability fgets exists to prevent.
prompt: A user pastes a 200-character line at the prompt. Can it overflow buf?
snippet:
char buf[64];
fgets(buf, sizeof buf, stdin);
